assumptions: Normalization is applied inside Version.__init__ so every public entry point benefits.
Only dotted-numeric releases followed by a dash and a post number are normalized; all other inputs are unchanged.
The reported test counts come from `pytest -q` over the full suite, which also collects parametrized cases.

requirements.text: Version("1.0-1") parses and str() returns "1.0.post1"; normalization happens in Version.__init__.
A regression test in tests/test_version.py covers the "1.0-1" -> "1.0.post1" normalization.
